correctness.rationale: For every n, all clamps are exactly the idempotents: a monotone step-0-or-1 idempotent fixes its full image interval, hence clamps outside. Commutation equivalently forces p=g(a),q=g(b) into the interval and makes non-boundary tails constant; free boundary tails contribute (1+z)^l,(1+z)^r, while binomial interior step counts control image rank. The sufficiency is checked on all three regions, including h=1. Generating function follows by explicit finite sums and formal geometric-series identities. Standalone check.py enumerates actual maps/compositions for n<=9 and matches every coefficient and four weighted generating series specializations. Infinite result comes from the proof, not from finite tests.

value.rationale: Full natural parameterized centralizer-rank census for a studied sequence of nontrivial finite monoids; computes exact number of commuting partners at every rank for EACH individual clamp, and complete two-rank bivariate series over every n. This is a more informative invariant than the pre-existing |M_n|, |E_n| or OEIS unweighted totals. It also yields the sharp asymptotic 32/n^2 commuting probability and separates edge vs interior clamp effects. Not merely a finite exercise or substitution; the result solves a complete enumeration problem uniformly.
